features.description: Convergence breakers use progress-aware finding semantics. no_progress and diminishing_returns must not terminate rounds that are making real progress by shrinking or changing blocking findings, and supervisor breaker precedence must not mask progress before max_iterations or signoff.
features.acceptance: Design B (D003) semantics: check_no_progress and check_diminishing_returns treat a STRICTLY-SHRINKING blocking-finding-signature count across the window as PROGRESS and do not trip — even when some findings persist (the signature intersection is non-empty). Flat-but-changed sets ({A}->{B}) and growing sets ({A}->{A,B}) are NOT progress and continue to terminate: verdict-identity no_progress and signature-intersection diminishing_returns are preserved for them, which keeps the pre-existing thrashing-termination contract (plan 2026-05-04-003 test_legitimate_no_progress_still_terminates_stopped_no_progress) intact. Supervisor call sites pass auditor envelopes (not bare verdict strings) into check_no_progress so it compares finding-signature SETS. Timeout-with-work carve-out preserved. Signature-unavailable fallback (any finding missing issue text) reverts to verdict-string equality and is documented + tested. NOTE: the codex batched audit (evidence/codex-batched-audit-i0.json) flagged the prior 'identical-set-only / changing=progress' wording as drift from Design B; reconciled here per D005 — the code is correct on the merits (growing/flat-changed are not progress) and broadening it would break the timeout_with_work regression contract.
steps: Read circuit_breakers.check_no_progress, check_diminishing_returns, compute_audit_finding_signature, and the supervisor.py breaker call order.
Change check_no_progress signature to accept prior + current auditor envelopes (or findings lists); compute signature sets; trip only on identical persisted blocking signatures.
Audit and correct check_diminishing_returns so finding-set shrink/change across rounds does not trip as diminishing returns.
Update supervisor call sites and breaker ordering/precedence so progress-making needs_changes rounds can continue until max_iterations or signoff.
Preserve the reason-string contract and classification sidecars for stopped_no_progress and diminishing-returns terminals.

features.description: Latest-auditor-envelope selection is mtime or supersession aware. Finalizer, closeout, and closeout-memo paths must choose the freshest valid auditor verdict for a feature rather than blindly preferring the highest iteration index left on disk.
features.acceptance: signed_off_finalizer + closeout + closeout-memo auto-lift resolve the latest auditor envelope by mtime (or explicit supersession marker), not iteration index alone. A fresh i0 signed_off outranks a stale i1 needs_changes from a superseded run. latest_audit_status reflects the true latest verdict.
steps: Locate every 'latest auditor envelope' selection: closeout._latest_auditor_envelope, signed_off_finalizer, memo lift.
Switch ranking to mtime (or supersession sidecar) with index as tie-break.
Optionally have re-dispatch mark superseded envelopes.
Keep behavior identical when only one envelope per feature exists (the common case).

features.description: Regression suite and full orchestrate sweep. Add focused red/green tests for convergence breaker behavior and latest-envelope selection, then prove the existing orchestrate test sweep remains green except for any explicitly documented pre-existing baseline failure.
features.acceptance: Red/green tests (Design B per D003): (a) no_progress does NOT trip when the finding-signature count strictly SHRINKS across needs_changes rounds; DOES trip when the set is flat (whether identical or changed, e.g. {A}->{B}) or growing — matching the thrashing-termination contract; (b) diminishing_returns does NOT trip on strictly-shrinking sets; DOES trip when a finding persists without strict shrinkage; (c) breaker precedence does not mask a strictly-shrinking progress volley before max_iterations/signoff; (d) finalizer picks fresher-by-mtime signed_off over stale higher-index needs_changes. Full existing orchestrate test sweep passes under raw pytest (1 pre-existing unrelated failure). Synthetic 3-round volley with strictly-shrinking findings (3->1->0) converges to signed_off at round 3 instead of false stopped_no_progress/stopped_diminishing_returns at round 2; flat-distinct and growing volleys still terminate at round 2 (surgical-fix regression guards).
steps: Write red tests for F001 (finding-set vs verdict-string, diminishing_returns false-positive, and breaker precedence) + F002 (mtime selection).
Full orchestrate sweep under raw pytest (env-isolated).
